content:
emily: Onboarding argo-21b-int4 today. Canary perf looks fine but we hit two CUDA OOMs on long chat completions (~180-320 tokens). Low frequency but repro in stress.

raj: Paste the pod log snippet?

emily:
```
2026-03-02T11:09:05Z runtime: cuda alloc failed: out of memory
serving/kv: slot_alloc attempts=3, contiguous_alloc_fail=true
runtime: eviction tried but compaction skipped (no window)
```

theo: Contiguous_alloc_fail suggests fragmentation. What are the model defaults from catalog?

emily: max_new_tokens=384, continuous_batching=true, prefetch_window=8, max_batch_size=24. Workload is long-summary so many requests hit full max_new_tokens.

raj: Short term I'd do: 1) reduce max_new_tokens to 96 for the int4 variant; 2) drop prefetch_window to 2; 3) set max_batch_size=8 for canary. That reduces peak contiguous needs.

emily: Agreed. Also running `runtimectl defrag --gpu=all --drain=10s` before traffic spike.

theo: Add a runtime safety: if contiguous_free < largest_request then trigger prefix-evict + fail-fast before trying to allocate huge chunk. I'll open a small patch. Also add telemetry counter contiguous_alloc_fail.

ops-bot: deploy/argo-21b-int4-canary started (id:dpl-20260302-7) :rocket:

emily: Repro command I used: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/models/argo-21b-int4/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY" \
  -d '{"input":"<very-long-prompt>","max_new_tokens":256}'
```

raj: If it OOMs capture `/internal/allocator/slabmap` and attach. If defrag reduces holes, we should be able to promote.

emily: Ran stress after changes: zero OOMs in 30m, latency stable. Ops reports defrag ran successfully. Will keep canary at reduced defaults for 12h then evaluate.

theo: Follow up: medium-term, consider buddy allocator fallback for large contiguous allocations and a per-model soft-start (ramped max_batch_size). I'll draft RFC.
